name: Customer Email Triage Assistant
description: Classifies incoming customer support emails and drafts suggested replies. Agents review and send every reply; the assistant cannot send email or change customer records.
documentation: Emails contain names and contact details. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Emails are retained for 12 months on a documented lawful basis and then deleted. The vendor is documented and a data processing agreement is signed. Access uses least-privilege read-only permissions. All requests and agent edits are audit-logged. Customers are informed that AI assists with replies. A monthly review checks accuracy and bias.
